description: This source file defines the EmailSubscriberAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing email subscribers within the OrangeHRM admin module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting email subscriber records, and handles associated validation rules and external dependencies.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for managing email subscribers, supporting CRUD operations and integrating with the EmailSubscriberService.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EmailSubscriber entity based on request parameters and saves it to the database.

methods.name: setParamsToEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Populates an EmailSubscriber object with data from request parameters, associating it with an email subscription.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple email subscribers based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for delete operation parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single email subscriber by ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for fetching a single email subscriber.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email subscriber with new data from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating email subscriber data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Generates validation rules for the request body when creating or updating an email subscriber.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates a unique validation constraint option for email subscriber email field, ignoring current entity during updates.
